status: Offline preparation only; execution not authorized

clientProposal.provider: Current user-configured provider; recheck actual route before dispatch without exposing credentials

scope: Explicit-path Skill invocation over immutable public synthetic source packets. No Git collector execution, automatic-discovery or live-repository completeness claim.
readPolicy: Deliver only each run's manifest-listed files plus its bootstrap. Load core and exactly one mode reference, JavaScript, and release-risk for Deep. No oracle/plan/history/other-run files. Read-only file tools or bounded cat/sed reads only; no source execution, shell evaluation, Git, collector, browser, network, credentials or repository-wide search. No writes.
stopPolicy: Assess each unedited result before the next run. A quality failure stops later stages; finish a pair only when its first run remains valid. Tool-boundary breach, source drift, unavailable complete delivery, or model/provider mismatch stops immediately. Retain failures; no automatic retry, replacement, follow-up or report correction. Investigate offline before a new separately frozen window.
qualityGates: All oracle-required findings/closures/evidence gaps covered; zero unsupported findings, incorrect severity or invented observations.
Chinese mode sections, Origin/Reproduction, Finding IDs and changed-condition rules pass the unchanged v0.6.0 profile.
Candidate Quick/Deep compact file grammar passes against independently adjudicated accounting; correct denominator, layers, gaps and scope.
Both Fix reports preserve issue identity, counts, focused scope and no file/condition ledger.
Conclusion and final recommendation use the same evidence-backed decision and prerequisites; no critical-gap unconditional approval.
Complete material delivery, unchanged before/after pins and zero outside-scope/tool/write violations. Read traces alone do not prove semantic coverage.

costBudget.purpose: Conservative pilot gates, not a claim of statistical improvement or an accepted price increase.
costBudget.fileCoverageOutputBudget: One summary line plus one line per incomplete file, plus one inventory-gap line only if enumeration is incomplete. Fix adds zero lines.
costBudget.telemetry: Record input/output/reasoning/cached tokens as separately reported, total elapsed time, tool/read calls, duplicate reads, report UTF-8 bytes, delivered bytes and unavoidable instruction delta. Do not double-count reasoning included in output or substitute byte estimates for tokens. Use identical provider/model/settings and cache accounting for a pair.
costBudget.missingOrIncomparableTelemetry: Unknown; hold cost acceptance and promotion, do not rerun solely to select a lower cost. Byte/read counts cannot prove token or monetary savings.
costBudget.monetaryClaims: None unless provider prices and cache billing are known and comparable; token ceilings are a pilot proxy, not monetary cost proof.
costBudget.failure: Hold the next stage and promotion. Record the exceeded gate and inspect offline; do not relax thresholds after seeing the results.
